summary: Iteration 2 testing: 28/28 backend tests passed (meta, parse-line, per-user permissions, users overview, stats breakdowns/filters, CSV header, settings models dedup, wiki CRUD, wiki AI generate called ONCE, instructions). Full frontend flows exercised with Playwright for admin and viewer (Equipo navigation, Registro new entry with model=GPT-5, Wiki CRUD + AI panel, Instrucciones, Dashboard breakdowns + model filter). All critical acceptance criteria pass. One cosmetic hydration warning stemming from Visual-Edits dev wrapper (span inside option).

issues: React hydration warning in dev console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Caused by Visual Edits dev wrapper injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside dynamic <option> elements (e.g. wiki-tag-select P1 option, filter-* selects). Not functionally breaking but should be suppressed for clean console.

action_items: Optional: silence Visual-Edits wrapper on <option> children (span inside option) to clear the hydration warning in Wiki/FiltersBar selects.
critical_code_review_comments: wiki.py uses model id 'claude-sonnet-5-5' which is non-standard but the Emergent LLM gateway accepts it (observed 200 response); worth confirming it maps to a real model and not silently falling back.
cronos.py EntryIn.user defaults to None; create_entry correctly forces viewer email and admin can override — good.
wiki PATCH returns the full doc including 'history'; create returns a copy without history — asymmetric but acceptable.
Users overview includes role via role_for(email) which only recognises ADMIN_EMAILS; verified correct for test accounts.
test_credentials: ADMIN session_token=test_session_e1 (fran.gomez@disruptivos.com), VIEWER session_token=test_session_viewer (viewer.test@disruptivos.com). Both left in place as instructed.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed added. All TEST_ entries and TEST_ wiki docs cleaned up after tests. The one-time wiki/generate call created no persisted doc (endpoint returns markdown only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py plus pre-existing /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (iteration 1). pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; run sequentially with 'pytest -n 0' if dependencies between classes matter. The wiki/generate endpoint consumes real credits — guard any new tests to call it at most once. Visual-Edits wrapper injects spans into dynamic <option> elements; purely cosmetic. filter-user-select auto-populates from ?user= query param correctly, but requires ~1-2s for meta to load the option list before input_value returns the right value in Playwright.
rca of the issue: No critical issues identified. Hydration warning RCA: Visual-Edits runtime wraps array-mapped children in <span data-ve-dynamic style='display:contents'>, which is illegal inside <option>. Fix would be in the Visual-Edits dev plugin (not app code) or suppress the warning.
